correctness.rationale: Direct edge-coefficient equations give kernel dimension c(G[S])+|V|-|N[S]| exactly; cyclic runs convert the rank to sum of Bernoulli triple indicators with a single all-one correction. The four-state transfer matrix counts every binary support and corrects its exceptional all-one coefficient. Substituting t=1/q yields the explicit characteristic-factorization and commuting degree. Direct finite-dependence covariance calculations prove exact mean/variance for n>=5; a bounded two-dependent sequence with strictly positive long-run variance yields the Gaussian law. A fully standalone verifier independently enumerated finite-field adjoint matrix ranks over F2 and F3, checked transfer coefficients at q=2,3,4,5,9, and exact moments, returning VERIFY_OK. Finite experiments are corroborative, not substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: The distribution of inner-derivation ranks and element commuting probability are natural intrinsic invariants of finite Lie algebras, linked to centralizer stratification. Cyclic graphical two-step Lie algebras are a canonical studied infinite class; the closed transfer, root-based exponential commutativity law, exact cycle corrections and explicit nontrivial Gaussian fluctuations supply meaningful structural and probabilistic information across all lengths and field orders. The result is more than a selected small count or routine renaming.
